title: 第十二章 丹方
content_zh:
“哎呀，反正跟你说了也不懂，这其中的奥妙很是繁杂，跟着师傅好好看着好好学吧。”
“哦，原来如此。”假装思索状的李火旺此时在想着别的事情。
丹阳子给自己的那丹药明显是有用的，这同样代表这个世界的法则跟自己的世界完全不一样的。
如果想要对付丹阳子，对于这个陌生的世界事情他还需要了解更多。
“小说里的修真者？不像，哪有拿人炼丹的修真者？哪有还要奴役凡人协助自己成仙的修真者？”
“而且按照惯例，普通修仙门他不是应该送一本建基的功法给我吗？为什么也没有？”
随着李火旺对这个地方越了解，就越觉的这个道观越怪，完全没有过去他概念中修道之人的样子。
“对了，玄阳师弟，师兄我教你个乖，你最好在师傅动嘴前，把事情都妥当的准备好了。”
“就比如昨天的丹药吧，因为你的癔症发作，错过了时辰，你如果在后天子时之前，把药引提前送过去，不就等于向师傅他老人家赔礼道歉了吗？”
“别看师傅喜怒无常，但是你只要把他哄开心了，自然会有你的好处。”
“昨天的丹料？”李火旺愣了一下。
“对啊，怎么，你忘了？昨天师傅让你送什么了？”
“白.....白灵淼。”李火旺的瞳孔瞬间缩到了极小，之前发生了那么多事情，可是这件事情还没结束呢，
如果自己没有在后天之前想到办法，那个白化病的姑娘就要跟之前的所有药引一样，被垂成肉泥了！
李火旺不知道怎么回的自己的住所，他躺在自己的石床上，那缠着红线的金脚环如同烧红的铁块般按在他的胸口，催促着他想出办法来。
可是现在丹阳子跟李火旺的实力相差极大不说，整个道观内全是他的人。
之前那些死去师兄的前车之鉴，也表明盲目逃跑是没用的。
就在辗转反侧之中，一晚上就过去了。
在上早课的前夕，李火旺穿起衣服，向着洞外走去。
他想去丹房看看，去找找那边有什么其他办法没有。

举着油灯刚走出来，一张尖嘴猴腮的脸从黑暗中冒了出来，把李火旺吓了一跳，那是狗娃的脸。
“嘿嘿嘿，李师兄，没什么事，我就是看昨天您一天都没来料房，实在有些担心，就过来看看您。”
“白师妹没事吧？”李火旺后退一步问道。
“没事没事，您亲自开口说让白师妹来代管料房，谁敢不听话，嘿嘿嘿，李师兄就是厉害，你看，自从你掌管料库后，还没带走一个人呢。”
听到狗娃说这话，李火旺心中感到十分的烦躁，他用油灯格开这家伙，大步走了出去。
当李火旺来到炼丹房，发现一些起的早的童子已经开始拿着麻布清洗丹炉跟地板了。
一位童子更是站在石翁里，拿着猪毛刷子，用力刷着石壁上的残余肉沫。
作为丹阳子的弟子，他进炼丹房，自然没有人敢说什么。
李火旺装作随意的走动，视线开始向着四周仔细观察。
整个炼丹房十分的简约，除了占了三分之一空间的巨大黑色丹炉外，就只剩下一个丹阳子用来砸人的石瓮跟石棒了。
别说炼丹的书籍了，连墙上的字画都没有一张，而且整个房间非常的空旷，任何掩体都没有。
“你在看什么？”一道熟悉但又毛骨悚然的声音忽然在他身后响起。
李火旺回头一看来人，连忙双手行礼。“师傅。”
“我问你在看什么？”
李火旺心中迅速思索了一秒，马上想到了一个由头。“弟子看师傅炼丹之道如此厉害，所以心生仰慕，就想着弟子什么时候也能到那种地步。”
丹阳子对李火旺的态度转变很是满意，看来这小家伙彻底想通了。
他双手背在身后，围绕着黑色炼丹炉转着。“有上进心是好事，但不是道爷不教你，而是外丹之道可没那么简单的。”
“寻常丹药还好说，可如果你想以丹道成仙，必须外丹内丹一起炼，本道爷炼到现在即将大乘，可是花了好一番功夫。”
丹阳子的脸上露出一丝得意跟兴奋，仿佛在畅享成仙后的自己过上神仙日子。
“师傅.....马上要成仙了吗？”

李火旺这话一出，丹阳子脸上的表情收了回来、“成仙之事没那么简单，路途漫长，但是本道爷肯定能成仙，你知道为什么吗？”
“不知。”
丹阳子的神情变得有些激动起来。“因为成仙的办法是老君爷天书上写的，而且还是老君爷亲自送到我手上的，试问全天下还有谁能成仙？他说我能成仙。我肯定能成仙！”
“老君爷？这是哪位？那三位神像中的一位？”李火旺有点听不懂这类似神话的描述。
虽然半点没听懂，但是李火旺还是奉承的说道：“师傅所言极是，您定能成仙，与天地同寿！”
丹阳子很明显非常乐意听这话，丑陋的脸上笑开了花。
“哈哈哈，好好好，既然你想学炼丹，那我就先教你一个简单的润血丹丹方吧，你记下来。赤丹12两，香附子半斤，阳起石2两4钱......”
虽然莫名其妙有了意外收获，但李火旺当然不会说不要。
连忙想要笔墨记录下来，可是左右张望，整个丹方内什么笔墨都没有。
情急之下，他从丹炉下找了一块炭杂，干脆在自己道袍下摆上记录下来。
“……丑时三刻起炉，正当沐浴；以目寂照，以息吹嘘，以神熏蒸，以文火慢慢养之。卯时四刻开炉。”
“这个丹方拿去慢慢练，道爷先看看你的天赋如何。”
李火旺扔掉手中的炭杂，双手捧着送到丹阳子的面前。“师傅，您看弟子记得可有遗漏？”
可看到那写满炭字的下摆呈现在自己面前时，刚刚还眉开眼笑的丹阳子脸上瞬间晴转多云。
右脚一抬，直接把李火旺踹飞了出去，撞在丹炉上嗡的一响后，又重重的摔在地上。
丹阳子铁青着脸，骂骂咧咧的背着手直接离开了，就这么把李火旺晾在原地。
当心中情绪化的怒意逐渐散去，李火旺感觉到这件事情非常蹊跷，自己并没有做什么，他为什么忽然这种态度？
李火旺低头看着手中的丹方思索起来，自己的字虽然难看，可这明显还是能辨认的出来啊。
忽然李火旺想到了什么，他张望着四周没有任何字画摆设的炼丹房，紧接着又想起上早课时，所有人都没有任何经书。
一个突如其来的念头在李火旺脑海中蹦出，“难道说这癞子头是个文盲，他不识字？”
content_en:
"Oh, I don't understand it even if I tell you. The secrets are very complicated. Just watch and learn from the master."
"Oh, that's it." Li Huowang, who pretended to be thinking, was thinking about other things at this time.
The elixir Danyangzi gave him was obviously useful, which also meant that the laws of this world were completely different from his own.
If he wants to deal with Danyangzi, he needs to know more about this strange world.
"The cultivators in novels? It's not like that. How can there be cultivators who use people to make elixirs? How can there be cultivators who want to enslave mortals to help them become immortals?"
"And according to the usual practice, shouldn't he give me a foundation-building technique for ordinary cultivators? Why not?"
As Li Huowang got to know more about this place, the Taoist temple became stranger and weirder. It had nothing like the Taoist cultivators he had imagined in the past.
"By the way, Junior Brother Xuanyang, I'll teach you to be a good boy. You'd better prepare everything properly before the master speaks."
"Just like yesterday's elixir. Because you had a hysterical attack and missed the time, if you send the elixir ahead of time before the day after tomorrow, wouldn't it be equivalent to an apology to the master?"
"It doesn't matter that the master is moody, but as long as you make him happy, it will naturally benefit you."
"Yesterday's pill material?" Li Huowang was stunned for a moment.
"Yes, why, you forgot? What did the master ask you to give yesterday?"
"Bai...Bai Lingmiao." Li Huowang's pupils shrank to a minimum in an instant. So many things had happened before, but this matter is not over yet.
If I didn't think of a solution before the day after tomorrow, the albino girl would be reduced to a pulp like all the previous Yaoyin!
Li Huowang didn't know how to get back to his residence. He was lying on his stone bed, and the gold anklet wrapped with red thread pressed against his chest like a red-hot iron, urging him to come up with a solution.
But now there is a huge difference in strength between Danyangzi and Li Huowang, and the entire Taoist temple is full of his people.
The lessons learned from the previous brothers who died also show that blind escape is useless.
In the midst of tossing and turning, the night passed.
On the eve of morning class, Li Huowang put on his clothes and walked out of the cave.
He wanted to visit the alchemy room and see if there were any other options there.
As soon as he walked out holding an oil lamp, a face with a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks emerged from the darkness, which startled Li Huowang. It was the face of Gou Wa.
"Hehehe, Senior Brother Li, nothing's wrong. I just saw that you didn't come to the cooking room all day yesterday, so I was really worried, so I came over to see you."
"Junior sister Bai, are you okay?" Li Huowang took a step back and asked.
"It's okay, it's okay. You personally asked Junior Sister Bai to take charge of the material room. Who dares to be disobedient? Hehehe, Senior Brother Li is awesome. Look, you haven't taken away a single person since you took charge of the material room."
Hearing Gou Wa say this, Li Huowang felt very irritated. He blocked the guy with an oil lamp and strode out.
When Li Huowang came to the alchemy room, he found that some boys who had gotten up early were already cleaning the alchemy furnace and the floor with linen cloths.
A boy stood in the stone urn, holding a pig-hair brush and vigorously brushing the remaining flesh foam on the stone wall.
As a disciple of Danyangzi, no one dared to say anything when he entered the alchemy room.
Li Huowang pretended to move around casually and began to look around carefully.
The entire alchemy room is very simple. Apart from the huge black alchemy furnace that takes up one third of the space, there is only a stone urn and stone rod that Danyangzi uses to hit people.
Not to mention the books on alchemy, there wasn't even a calligraphy or painting on the wall, and the whole room was very empty without any cover.
"What are you looking at?" A familiar but creepy voice suddenly sounded behind him.
Li Huowang turned around and looked at the person.He quickly saluted with both hands. "Master."
"I asked what are you looking at?"
Li Huowang thought quickly for a second and immediately thought of a reason. "The disciple saw that the master's alchemy skills were so powerful, so he admired him and thought about when he could reach that level."
Danyangzi was very satisfied with Li Huowang's change of attitude. It seemed that the little guy had completely figured it out.
He put his hands behind his back and circled the black alchemy furnace. "It's a good thing to be motivated, but it's not that Taoist master won't teach you, but the way of Waidan is not that simple."
"Ordinary elixirs are easy to say, but if you want to use elixirs to become immortals, you must refine the outer elixir and inner elixir together. I am about to practice the Mahayana until now, but it took a lot of effort."
Danyangzi's face showed a trace of pride and excitement, as if he was enjoying the life of a god after becoming an immortal.
"Master...will you become an immortal soon?"
As soon as Li Huowang said these words, the expression on Danyangzi's face turned back, "Becoming an immortal is not that simple. The road is long, but I will definitely become an immortal. Do you know why?"
"I don't know."
Danyangzi's expression became a little excited. "Because the way to become an immortal is written in the heavenly book of Master Lao Jun, and it was delivered to me personally by Master Lao Jun. Who else in the world can become an immortal? He said that I can become an immortal. I will definitely become an immortal!"
"Old Lord? Who is this? One of those three statues?" Li Huowang was a little confused by this myth-like description.
Although he didn't understand at all, Li Huowang still said flatteringly: "What the master said is absolutely true. You will definitely become an immortal and live as long as heaven and earth!"
Danyangzi was obviously very happy to hear this, with a smile on his ugly face.
"Hahaha, okay, okay, since you want to learn alchemy, let me teach you a simple blood-moistening elixir recipe first. You can write it down. 12 taels of red elixir, half a catty of cyperus rotundus, 2 taels of actinolite and 4 qian..."
Although he had an unexpected gain inexplicably, Li Huowang certainly would not say no.
I quickly wanted to write it down with pen and ink, but I looked around and saw that there was no pen and ink in the entire Danfang.
In desperation, he found a piece of charcoal from under the alchemy furnace and simply recorded it on the hem of his Taoist robe.
"... Start the stove at three o'clock in the Chou hour, just in time to take a bath; illuminate it with silent eyes, brag with your breath, fumigate it with spirit, and raise it slowly with a slow fire. Turn on the stove at four o'clock in the Mao hour."
"Take this recipe and practice it slowly. Master Tao will first see how your talent is."
Li Huowang threw away the charcoal in his hand and held it in front of Danyangzi with both hands. "Master, do you think my disciple has forgotten anything?"
But when he saw the hem with the word "charcoal" written on it appeared in front of him, the face of Danyangzi who had just been smiling suddenly turned from sunny to cloudy.
He raised his right foot and kicked Li Huowang away. He hit the alchemy furnace with a buzzing sound and then fell heavily to the ground.
Danyangzi's face was livid, he cursed and left directly with his hands behind his back, leaving Li Huowang where he was.
When the emotional anger in his heart gradually dissipated, Li Huowang felt that this matter was very strange. He didn't do anything. Why did he suddenly have such an attitude?
Li Huowang looked down at the elixir in his hand and thought about it. Although his handwriting was ugly, it was still clearly legible.
Suddenly Li Huowang thought of something. He looked around the alchemy room without any calligraphy and painting decorations. Then he remembered that during the morning class, no one had any scriptures.
A sudden thought popped into Li Huowang's mind, "Could it be that this scoundrel is illiterate? He can't read?"
